irq: Confirm that request_irq/devm_request_irq registration and free target the same runtime dev_id owner. Check free_irq, devm lifetime handling, disable_irq, synchronize_irq, interrupt masking, probe error rollback, and whether the interrupt handler can still execute while the object or a subobject is being freed.
workqueue: Confirm the exact work_struct owner and workqueue identity. Check whether cancel_work_sync, cancel_delayed_work_sync, flush_work, flush_workqueue, and destroy_workqueue target the same object and occur in the correct order. Consider callback self-requeue and shared/system workqueues.
kthread: Confirm that the kernel thread uses the same runtime object. Check kthread_stop, completion/join, stop flags, wakeups, reference counts, and whether the thread can still access the object after teardown/free begins.
tasklet: Confirm the owner of the embedded tasklet_struct. Check whether tasklet_disable and tasklet_kill target the same object and occur before free. Consider callback execution and tasklet rescheduling on another CPU.
hrtimer: Confirm the owner of the embedded hrtimer. Check the identity and ordering of hrtimer_cancel/try_to_cancel, whether the callback restarts the timer or returns HRTIMER_RESTART, and whether another CPU can still execute the callback.
timer: Confirm the owner of timer_list. Check the identity and ordering of del_timer_sync/timer_shutdown_sync, whether the callback restarts the timer, mod_timer paths, and whether the callback can overlap teardown.
napi: Confirm the owner of napi_struct. Check napi_disable, netif_napi_del, poll synchronization, scheduling state, and whether poll can still access the owner during teardown.
rcu: Confirm the exact RCU/SRCU owner and callback type. Distinguish a delayed call_rcu callback from an external free path. Check grace periods, rcu_barrier/srcu_barrier, kfree_rcu/kvfree_rcu semantics, callback ordering, and whether the alleged free can actually overlap callback access.
default: Apply the relevant Linux lifetime, object-identity, and concurrency-synchronization semantics.
